label: prop:vol-through-tau
title: $\mathrm{Vol}(K)$ factors strictly through the fibre functor $\tau$
html:
Conditional on the Kashaev–Murakami–Murakami volume conjecture. Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a QOU with fibre functor \tau. For every braid \beta \in B_n, with image \rho(\beta) \in H_n(R, q) and closure K_\beta, the real-valued knot volume \mathrm{Vol}(K_\beta) factors strictly through \tau:

  \mathrm{Vol}(K_\beta)
  \;=\;
  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\bigl(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta)\bigr)
  \;=\;
  (\pi_\infty \circ \tau)\bigl(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta)\bigr).

There is no other archimedean route.

The quantifier is over braids \beta \in B_n, not general elements of H_n(R,q). The quotient homomorphism \rho : B_n \to H_n(R,q) is neither injective nor surjective, and a Hecke element outside \rho(B_n) has no link closure, so the statement assigns no volume to such an element. In particular, the linear combinations c\,\sigma_g + d\,\mathbf{1} are general Hecke elements rather than braids, and their volume is 0.

Identification. On the algebraic quantum volume, \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} coincides with \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{top}} = \pi_\infty \circ \chi_{\mathrm{top}}. The fibre functor \tau is the exclusive bridge to the laboratory continuum. The realization functor defines its canonical computation rule.

Sketch (conditional). The conjectural hypothesis is the Kashaev–Murakami–Murakami volume conjecture: the hyperbolic volume of the closure equals the Kashaev limit of the colored Jones polynomial (Kashaev–Murakami–Murakami volume conjecture). By Tannaka-Krein rigidity, any composite mapping \mathbf{C} to \mathbb{R} that preserves tensor products and dualities is uniquely isomorphic to the fibre functor \tau; the realization functor's computation rule evaluates \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} on the algebraic quantum volume \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta) as exactly the Kashaev limit. Conditional on the conjecture, the two identifications compose to \mathrm{Vol}(K_\beta) = \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta)) — this composition is the proved step, with the Kashaev identification taken as a hypothesis rather than asserted.
